request: Release the completed Empirical setup wizard and broad 73-target agent installer as npm package empirical-sdd version 0.20.3, verify the live registry artifact from a clean consumer, then push the release commits and matching v0.20.3 tag.
message: Published empirical-sdd@0.20.3 as npm latest, verified the registry tarball and exact shasum from a clean consumer, exercised all 73 installer entrypoints in an isolated home, and pushed annotated tag v0.20.3 for merged commit eff18f7.

evidence.summary: Registry reports 0.20.3 as latest with shasum b5f50f9619ceac5e2c7868d5f870f2da599f2d37. A clean npm consumer reported CLI 0.20.3 and installed 73 entrypoints across 65 destinations with five guidance integrations and 326 created skill files.
PR #6 merged at eff18f71c51672a954d5171126e1c128bceb4f44 after GitHub Actions passed on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows; annotated tag v0.20.3 was pushed to that exact commit.
